phrases.english: Can I have the bill, quickly?
phrases.korean: 이거 빨리 계산해 줄 수 있어요?
함께 쬐는 햇살, 더 밝은 날.

phrases.english: Sky of stars, your light with mine.
phrases.korean: 별이 찬 하늘, 네 빛과 내 빛.

phrases.english: Each new word, a step forward.
Be the sunlight, on a bloom.
New Korean word, heard. It stuck!
A single clear sound, echoes further.
Love, a silent echo, finds you.
Small lights, guide the long night.
Like a persistent vine, reach high.

phrases.korean: 비 온 뒤 해, 더 밝게 빛나요.

phrases.english: River carves stone, with time's touch.
Be a guiding star, in darkness.
Share your warmth, like the sun.
A small stream, can fill oceans.

phrases.korean: 천천히 숨 쉬어, 할 수 있어.

phrases.english: Taste new flavors, think new thoughts.
